evidence.quote: You can visually create, run, and monitor ETL pipelines to load data into your data lakes. Also, you can immediately search and query cataloged data using Athena, Amazon EMR, and Amazon Redshift Spectrum.
With AWS Glue, you can discover and connect to more than 100 diverse data sources and manage your data in a centralized data catalog.

claim: With AWS Glue, you can discover and connect to more than 100 diverse data sources and manage your data in a centralized data catalog, visually create, run, and monitor ETL pipelines to load data into your data lakes, and immediately search and query cataloged data using Athena, Amazon EMR, and Amazon Redshift Spectrum.
